menu.title: ⌯ Help center ✦ Choose a feature below to view its instructions and recommended usage

features.dl: ⌯ Download one post ✦ Open the channel and hold the post you want ✦ Choose Copy link and send it here ✦ You can also send /dl and follow its steps ✦ Example: https://t.me/example_channel/15 ✦ For a private source first link an account that is a member using /login ✦ The bot copies unrestricted posts or downloads protected files and uploads them ✦ Large files require your choice before splitting
features.bdl: ⌯ Download multiple posts ✦ Send /bdl without links to begin ✦ Copy the first post link from the source channel and send it ✦ Then send the last post link from the same channel ✦ Both posts and the posts between them are included ✦ Choose All or Only selected types or Except selected types then choose Start ✦ You can send both links at once ✦ Example: /bdl https://t.me/example_channel/15 https://t.me/example_channel/30 ✦ You receive a task number to cancel using /cancel ✦ Tasks resume from saved progress after a restart
features.clone: ⌯ Transfer a complete channel ✦ This feature needs a bot subscription ✦ Link an account that is a member using /login ✦ To send the content to another channel set it with /uploadch first ✦ Send /clone and then the source channel link ✦ Choose content filters and press Start ✦ Without a destination channel content accessed with your linked account goes to your Saved Messages ✦ Your task number lets you cancel with /cancel
features.monitor: ⌯ Monitor new posts ✦ This feature needs a bot subscription ✦ Send /monitor and choose a channel using the button or send its link ✦ Only new posts after activation are included ✦ Public channels use a pool account ✦ For a private channel link an account that is a member using /login ✦ Private accounts are checked hourly one at a time and closed after each check ✦ New posts enter a saved queue and are delivered in order ✦ Use the Stop monitoring button to disable it
features.channel_upload: ⌯ Choose an upload channel ✦ This feature needs a bot subscription ✦ Open your destination channel and go to its administrators ✦ Add this bot as an administrator with permission to post ✦ For uploads using your linked account add that account as an administrator too ✦ Send /uploadch and choose the destination channel ✦ New downloads and monitoring deliveries go there ✦ Use /rmuploadch to remove it ✦ A linked Telegram Premium account can upload files up to 4 GB whole ✦ Easiest way ↣ add the bot as an admin in your channel or group and it will ask you to confirm here
features.forcedownload: ⌯ Forced-download mode ✦ Use /forcedownload to make the bot retrieve and upload every file instead of copying unrestricted posts. This mode is useful for custom thumbnails and content reconstruction
features.login: ⌯ Link your Telegram account ✦ Send /login and choose your current account or another account ✦ For the current account press Share my phone number ✦ For another account send its number with its country code ✦ Telegram sends a login code to that account ✦ Enter it only with the numbered buttons ✦ If two-step verification is enabled send its password when asked and the bot deletes that message ✦ The linked account must be a member of any private source you use ✦ The login step lasts ten minutes and survives a bot restart ✦ Remove your linked session with /logout
features.points: ⌯ Download points ✦ Free downloads use daily, gift, and referral points. Share your personal link to earn more points: ✦ {referral_link}
features.premium: ⌯ Bot subscription ✦ Use /premium to see available plans ✦ Subscribers skip the shared free-user queue ✦ You can save up to five tasks that run one after another ✦ Channel transfer and monitoring and upload channels are included ✦ Custom captions and forced-download mode are also available ✦ Telegram Premium is a separate subscription needed for whole-file uploads above 2 GB ✦ An admin-granted subscription shows its duration in days and its expiry date
features.other_uses: ⌯ Other ways to use the bot ✦ Transfer one channel into another: Configure a destination using /uploadch, then run /clone on the source channel. Selected content will be transferred according to your filters ✦ Replace covers for a complete series: Send the new cover image to the bot and confirm it, enable forced-download mode, then run /bdl using the first and last episode links. The files will be downloaded and uploaded using the selected cover where supported

queue.limit_premium: ⌯ Your task list is full ✦ You can have up to {limit} open tasks ✦ Wait for one to finish or cancel it with /cancel
queue.lost_after_restart: ⌯ Task could not resume ✦ Task number: {task_id} ✦ The original message is unavailable ✦ Send its link again to start a new task
queue.cancel_usage: Send /cancel to choose a task or /cancel 123 with your task number
queue.not_found: Task {task_id} has already finished or does not belong to you
queue.choose_to_cancel: ⌯ Choose a task to cancel ✦ The buttons show your open tasks

spam.per_second: Please send no more than one message per second
spam.per_minute:
Please send no more than 20 messages per minute
This bot receives download links and does not need repeated messages
Wait until this minute ends
spam.buttons:
You pressed more than 20 buttons this minute
Wait before pressing another button
Repeated violations double your waiting time

flow.first_link: ⌯ Send a post link ✦ Open the source channel and hold the post you want ✦ Choose Copy link and send it here ✦ For multiple posts send the first post link now ✦ Example: https://t.me/example_channel/15
flow.last_link: ⌯ Send the last post link ✦ Copy the link of the last post you want from the same channel ✦ The bot downloads from the first post through the last including both ✦ You choose content types in the next step
flow.channel: ⌯ Choose the source channel ✦ Send its public link or username ✦ For a private channel send a post link and link an account that is already a member using /login ✦ Example: https://t.me/example_channel
flow.invalid_channel: Send a channel link or username or use the Choose a channel button
flow.upload_channel: ⌯ Choose an upload channel ✦ Easiest way ↣ add the bot as an admin allowed to post in your channel or group ✦ The bot will send you a confirmation here so tap Confirm ✦ Or tap the pick channel button below ✦ Or send the channel link, its username or the ID that starts with -100 ✦ This feature needs a bot subscription

panel.title: ⌯ Admin panel ✦ Choose what you want to manage
panel.choose_user: Choose users or send their numeric IDs
panel.link_days: Link validity in days with zero for no expiry
panel.point_days: Points validity in days with zero for no expiry
panel.send_broadcast:
Send the broadcast message here
The bot shows a copy for you to check
Choose the audience then confirm
panel.send_language:
Send a JSON language file named with its language code such as ar.json
An existing language is replaced only after the file is valid
panel.enter_value:
Send your number or comma-separated user IDs
Your reply is deleted and this menu is updated
panel.invalid_value:
Send a valid positive number or comma-separated user IDs
For gift expiry zero means no expiry
panel.send_admin:
Send the numeric ID of the user to appoint, or forward one of their messages
Press an admin below to remove them
panel.admin_exists: This user is already an admin

large.split_notice: ⌯ This file needs splitting ✦ Size: {size} ✦ The bot can upload about 2 GB in each part ✦ Choose Download and split to continue or Cancel to remove this task and your link ✦ To receive up to 4 GB as one file link a Telegram Premium account using /login and choose an upload channel using /uploadch
large.premium_notice: ⌯ Choose where to receive the large file ✦ Size: {size} ✦ Your linked Telegram Premium account can upload this file whole to your Saved Messages ✦ For automatic whole-file uploads to a channel choose a destination using /uploadch ✦ You can also choose Download and split
large.help: ⌯ Large files explained ✦ A bot upload is limited to about 2 GB ✦ Your subscription to this bot is separate from Telegram Premium ✦ To upload a file up to 4 GB whole link a Telegram Premium account with /login ✦ For a destination channel add the bot and your linked account as administrators then use /uploadch to choose it ✦ Without a destination channel choose Send to my Saved Messages ✦ With an ordinary account choose Download and split to receive numbered file parts ✦ Use a file joining tool to put document parts back together in their numbered order

referral_check.question: ⌯ Quick check ✦ Solve this to confirm you are a real person and keep your referral ✦ {a} + {b} = ?
referral_check.failed: ⌯ Referral not counted ✦ Your referral did not count because the check was not solved. You can still use the bot normally
